blocking_findings.title: Unknown protected-read failure can become accepted on the second read without establishing eligible expiry
blocking_findings.detail: The first unknown enters the lease for every subtype. Under-lease False returns at594-595 before stale same-boot checks608-609 or fresh direct evidence611-617. A transient unreadable or corrupt protected file, missing proof, or wrong-boot proof followed by a fresh second read is accepted without any owner evidence. This exceeds the frozen scope that only protected valid expired same-boot negative proof may recover and corrupt/unavailable/missing/otherboot stay closed.
blocking_findings.focused_reproduction: CANDIDATE-UNKNOWN-REPLAY.json: four actual candidate.latch + actual read_latch_status cases, synthetic first protected read failure/state then valid fresh state; all returned False with evidence=None and exactly two protected reads. No VM or writes.
blocking_findings.required_before_acceptance: Constrain recovery to positively established eligible expired proof; do not use a second successful projection to rescue the initially forbidden categories. Supply frozen corrected bytes/hash and focused regression for these transitions, persistent sticky positives and intended stale recovery.
